lines.text: Darkness covers the land until the ninth hour, and Jesus cries out, "Why have You forsaken Me?"
Some bystanders think Jesus is calling Moses, and one man holds up a sponge of sour wine for Him.
Jesus yields up His spirit, and the temple veil is torn in two from top to bottom.
The earth quakes and the tombs break open, and the raised saints enter the holy city after Jesus' resurrection.
The terrified centurion says Jesus was a great prophet, and women who followed Him from Galilee watch from a distance.
